title: Image writers accept failed or short I/O as a successful save
description:
indigo_avi.c:50-79, 338-344; indigo_ser.c:96-133: bool helpers consume long-valued indigo_uni_write/seek directly. -1 is true, so disk/seek failure can be reported as success, frame count advanced and corrupt/truncated recording accepted. AVI additionally assigns realloc directly without checking at lines 328-332, risking NULL dereference/loss of offset allocation. Next: Compare writes with exact requested size and seeks with >= 0; keep temporary realloc and advance counts only after complete write. Inject ordinary write/seek/allocation failures and verify false/cleanup. CCD local-save branches use !indigo_uni_write even though -1/positive short counts indicate failure, leaving IMAGE_FILE OK and incomplete files. Include both CCD branches and DSLR save callers in exact-byte/error cleanup regressions.
